mwassistant-desc: MW Assistant — MediaWiki-aware AI assistant powered by MCP.
mwassistant-summary: Chat with the wiki's MW Assistant. Ask questions about pages, categories, and structured data.
mwassistantembeddings-summary: Inspect vector embedding status by namespace and trigger updates for individual pages or whole namespaces.
apierror-mwassistant-invalid-jwt: JWT verification failed. Token may be expired, have an invalid signature, or have insufficient scope.
apierror-mwassistant-user-mismatch: The requested user does not match the user the token was issued for.
apierror-mwassistant-smw-unavailable: Semantic MediaWiki is not installed on this wiki.
mwassistant-search-icon-title: Ask MW Assistant about this query
mwassistantembeddings-batch-queued: Queued $1 page {{PLURAL:$1|update|updates}} for background processing. {{PLURAL:$2|$2 page is|$2 pages are}} already up to date.
mwassistantembeddings-batch-nothing-to-d: Nothing to do — {{PLURAL:$1|the page is|all $1 pages are}} already up to date.
mwassistantembeddings-reload-hint: Reload this page to see progress.
mwassistantembeddings-page-not-found: The page "$1" does not exist or you do not have permission to read it.
mwassistantembeddings-invalid-namespace: Embeddings cannot be updated for this namespace.
